# BSB Market

> BSB Market is a Nigerian all-in-one marketplace and business app by BSB Global Tech Ltd (Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria). In one app, people and businesses can buy and sell goods, find jobs and gig work, book rides and dispatch deliveries, and book services — with in-app payments held in escrow until the buyer confirms delivery.

Key facts:

- Company: BSB Global Tech Ltd, incorporated in Nigeria. Address: 23 Urua Udofia, Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria. Email: team@bsbmarket.com (Monday–Saturday, 9am–6pm).
- Platforms: Android on Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.austindev.bsb). iOS app coming soon.
- Payments: all transactions must be paid through the in-app payment system. BSB Market holds the payment in escrow and releases it to the seller or provider after the buyer confirms delivery. Off-platform payments are not protected.
- Fees: signing up is free. During early-bird registration, listing products and applying for jobs cost 0 credits and business profile verification is free. BSB Market charges a disclosed commission or transaction fee on completed in-app transactions.
- Refunds (product purchases): report within 3 days of receipt; if approved, BSB Market Support issues a Refund Tag (RF-TAG); return the item within 5 days; the buyer receives 80% of the price (20% is a non-refundable handling fee).
- Disputes: reviewed by BSB Market Support; unresolved disputes go to mediation or arbitration under Nigeria's Arbitration and Mediation Act, 2023.
- Data protection: operates under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA).

## Core features

- [Marketplace](https://bsbmarket.com/marketplace): Buy and sell physical and digital products in Nigeria (gadgets, goods, cars, real estate, spare parts, ebooks, contracts, shares) with escrow-protected payments.
- [Jobs](https://bsbmarket.com/jobs): Find full-time, part-time, remote and gig jobs in Nigeria for free, or post vacancies and hire contractors who are paid through escrow.
- [Rides & Dispatch](https://bsbmarket.com/rides): Book a ride or a dispatch rider for packages and marketplace orders, with the price confirmed before booking and payment handled in-app.
- [Bookings](https://bsbmarket.com/bookings): Book services from salons, spas, photographers, trainers and other professionals, or take paid bookings for your business.
